data.name: Nishika
data.gender_notes: Nishika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nishika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nisha' which means 'night'. The suffix 'ka' is added to form a feminine name. In Hindu mythology, the night sky is adorned with stars which twinkle and light up the darkness. Nishika symbolizes the radiant beauty of the night sky and the wisdom that comes with it. The name Nishika carries the meaning “Night, Star” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nishika usually hope their child will grow to embody night, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
